Job Title: Student Athletic Events Worker (WS-ST1)

Classification: Student Employee (non-exempt)

Name and Address of Employer: St. Olaf College, 1520 St. Olaf Ave, Northfield, MN 55057

If the position requires the student to work off campus, provide the name and address here:

Department Name: Athletics

Unit Number (5 digits): 11725

Length of Position: See Employment Authorization  

Contact Person/Supervisor: Ice Arena and Events Manager

Wage Range: $12.00-13.00/hour

Description of the Position: (Purpose of the Position): Game Operations staff for athletic events. 

Transferable Skills: Facility management, business operations and functions, customer service, photography, videography, statistical analysis, data gathering and analysis, sports management.

Duties and Responsibilities: Tasks include: playing music, ball retrieval, scoreboard operations, public address announcer, set up and tear down of venues, ticket takers/sellers, and pride points attendants, statisticians, photographers, videographers, and concessions workers. Schedule management and other duties as assigned by athletic events manager, site managers, and athletic directors. 

Qualifications: (Education/Experience/Skills) Attention to detail. No experience required. General knowledge of sports is preferred but not required.

Physical and Environmental Factors:

This position requires grasping/handling, pushing/pulling, and lifting and carrying objects up to 50 lbs. to perform the essential functions. It also requires exposure to loud noise, wet or humid conditions indoors, extreme cold, as well as rare exposure to extreme heat and proximity hazards to perform the essential functions. Candidates must possess the ability to safely perform the physical work required of all duties with or without reasonable accommodation.

This job description is for general information purposes.  It is not intended to list all duties and responsibilities of the position.  This job description is subject to change at any time by St. Olaf College, with or without prior notice.
